svg.title: How to export your Kardia EKG as a PDF
svg.desc: Four phone screens. One: open the Kardia app and tap the History tab. Two: tap View EKG History. Three: tap the three dots next to a recording, then tap Download PDF. Four: skip the password step and tap the Share icon at the bottom left to print, send, or save the PDF.
